design: idle-scheduler design v2 section 3.2 (one vector per row) and 3.1; aae-orc-oprad
note: Shared by marvel and director. Each step's op is marry (Marry(input) == want, or the error when the step names one), take (AnswerTake), recheck (RecheckBeforeSend), address (MarryAddress: ok or the error), or grep (a source check of the named file, marvel only). want is compared after decoding, never as bytes, since empty fields are omitted. Decode strictly: an unknown field is an error. Cells use the asof.Cell JSON shape.

a hand claim outside the ledger prints DUPLICATE
